citation: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 6, section 6.4.3 DFT/ACK - post detail financial transactions (event P03), pp 6-12 to 6-13. Unprinted group names (ADR-019 decision 3): COMMON_ORDER (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.COMMON_ORDER.CONTENT), ORDER (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.ORDER.CONTENT), OBSERVATION (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.OBSERVATION.CONTENT), FINANCIAL (overrides.json: HL7 v2.4 Chapter 6, section 6.4.3 DFT/ACK - post detail financial transactions (event P03), pp 6-12 to 6-13: the unnamed group with first segment FT1 at the root (v2.4 prints no group names); named FINANCIAL from HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.FINANCIAL.CONTENT, the one root group of that bundle with first segment FT1, whose nested groups are the print's PR1, ORC, OBR and OBX groups by member set; the print adds DG1, DRG, GT1 and an insurance group per FT1 (its footnotes 3 to 5: 'specific to above FT1'), which the bundle lists only at the root (a bundle-differs row). The nested groups then take their names from the same bundle; the per-FT1 insurance group, which no bundle names, stays synthesised (P8b-13).), FINANCIAL_PROCEDURE (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.FINANCIAL_PROCEDURE.CONTENT), FINANCIAL_COMMON_ORDER (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.FINANCIAL_COMMON_ORDER.CONTENT), FINANCIAL_ORDER (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.FINANCIAL_ORDER.CONTENT), FINANCIAL_OBSERVATION (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.FINANCIAL_OBSERVATION.CONTENT), IN1_GROUP (synthesised: no HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd group under [FINANCIAL] has first segment IN1 and members {IN1, IN2, IN3, ROL}) and INSURANCE (HL7-xml v2.4/DFT_P03.xsd, DFT_P03.INSURANCE.CONTENT).
